div.head: I Atr 1.11
div.ab: Gif he ðonne betyhtled wurðe ⁊ he utt oþhleape, gylde se hlaford þæs mannes were þam cyninge.
Gyf he ðonne betyhtlad wurðe ⁊ he ut oðhleape, gylde se hlaford ðæs mannes were ðam cynge.
Sin autem accusetur aliquis et aufugiat, emendet dominus regi weram hominis accusati.
Gyf he ðonne betyhtlad wurðe ⁊ he ut oðhleape, gylde se hlaford ðæs mannes were ðam cynge.
And if a man is accused and escapes, the lord shall pay his wergeld to the king.
Wenn [deren] einer angeklagt wird, er jedoch hinaus entflieht, zahle der Herr dem König das Wergeld dieses Untergebenen.
If [one of them] is accused, but escapes, let the lord pay the king the wergild of that dependant.
